messages:
Anita: Heads-up — customer report: reconnect -> fallback route = double-charge. Console shows tokens attributed to both routes, billing looks duplicated. Anyone seen this?
Mike: yep, noticed a small spike last night in eu-prod. logs look like resume accepted by fallback while original connection still counted.
Dave: sounds like resume-window race. quota/accounting tags by session_id only, not route provenance.
Lisa: console currently attributes by 'route_label' from edge, but we don't surface resume provenance. UX will look like two independent sessions.
Anita: example from logs: ```edge: resume id=abc123 route=us-east -> fallback=eu-west
billing: event: charge session=abc123 tokens=120 route=eu-west
```
Mike: two actionable options: 1) include route provenance in billing events so we can dedupe; 2) emit a resume-race metric so console can highlight likely dupes.
Dave: agree but note schema changes for telemetry will ripple into cost pipeline. we need backwards compatibility.
Lisa: frontend idea: add a transient overlay that can show paired route events (original -> fallback) and mark billing-dedupe candidates. toggle off by default.
Anita: who can own billing change? @Mike?
Mike: I can do the billing-event change. plan: emit field `billing_provenance` = [original_route, final_route] and boolean `resume_dedupe_candidate` when accept_time - original_last_seen < 5s. gated behind FF.
Dave: I'll spec the telemetry: new counter `stream.resume_race` with tags {original_route, fallback_route, tenant, outcome}. Will keep cardinality low and backfill 7d sketches.
Lisa: frontend will add a small UI flag `show-fallback-pairs`. I'll post a figma mock and keep default off for canary.
OpsBot: Deploy queued: billing-service v2.14 -> staging at 02:30 UTC (feature-flag gated).
Anita: rollout plan: (1) feature-flag billing_provenance on staging, (2) deploy telemetry collector change, (3) enable frontend flag in canary, (4) monitor `stream.resume_race` + billing delta for 24h, (5) prod roll if stable.
Mike: timeline: start staging deploy today 02:30 UTC, FF default off. target prod roll tomorrow 03:00 UTC if no regressions.
Dave: alerting: I'll add a temporary PD if resume_race_rate > 0.5% of streaming sessions in 1h window.
Lisa: mock posted: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz (see page: route-fallback-overlay)
Anita: sounds good. Assigning @Sara to watch the console during canary.
Sara: :thumbsup: I'll be on watch for the 02:30 staging deploy and will report anomalies in #eng-platform.
Mike: one more detail — billing pipeline: dedupe logic will prefer final_route but will emit a dedupe marker so analytics can recompute totals.
Dave: also adding a debug flag to edge: `x-resume-provenance: true` to log paired events for a short window, will be safe in prod for low volume.
Lisa: UX note: add a tiny badge on route cards when `resume_dedupe_candidate` rate > 0.1% in last 30m.
Anita: thanks all. we'll triage followups after staging run. :white_check_mark:
